records.title: What Can We Learn from State Space Models for Machine Learning on Graphs?
records.reason: The primary abstract presents Graph State Space Convolution as an SSM extension for graph data, aimed at capturing long-range dependencies with efficient computation where graph transformers incur high computational overhead. It is a concrete sequence-architecture efficiency contribution, although its demonstrated application is graph learning rather than LLM serving.

records.title: BV Loss: Block Verification-Aware Loss for Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding
records.reason: The abstract derives a drafter training objective from block-verification acceptance and reports 13–21% more accepted tokens per verification call for diffusion speculative decoding. This directly targets inference work per verification call.

records.title: Half the Experts, All the Code: One-Shot Domain Pruning of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs for Coding
records.reason: The abstract describes one-shot domain pruning that removes about half the MoE experts while retaining coding performance, directly reducing deployed LLM model footprint and inference cost for a target domain.

records.title: Sink-Token-Aware Pruning for Fine-Grained Video Understanding in Efficient Video LLMs
records.reason: The abstract proposes sink-token-aware visual-token pruning for video LLMs and evaluates preserving fine-grained video understanding under aggressive token reduction. It directly addresses multimodal LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: Lightweight and Post-Training Structured Pruning for On-Device Large Language Models
records.reason: The arXiv primary manuscript (whose title contains the typographic form “Lanaguage”) describes COMP, hybrid layer/neuron structured pruning with mask tuning for on-device LLMs, reporting an 80% memory reduction for Llama-2 7B. The author’s official site lists the matching corrected title, authors, and IEEE TMC publication; the DOI URL itself did not resolve in the browser. This supports the DOI-to-manuscript identity via the primary author publication record and matching manuscript metadata.

records.title: Beyond Greedy Chunking: SLO-Aware Sliding-Window Scheduling for LLM Inference
records.reason: The abstract presents a sliding-window scheduler that adapts LLM inference chunking to service-level objectives, reporting increased capacity and fewer SLO violations. The mechanism targets serving throughput and latency directly.

records.title: MAS-Attention: Memory-Aware Stream Processing for Attention Acceleration on Resource-Constrained Edge Devices
records.reason: The abstract describes memory-aware attention streaming and heterogeneous vector/matrix computation for constrained edge devices, including measured acceleration on an NPU. This is a concrete attention inference memory/latency optimization.

records.title: Exploiting Student Parallelism for Efficient GPU Inference of BERT-like Models in Online Services
records.reason: The abstract applies student parallelism and adaptive pruning to BERT-like models in online services and reports latency/throughput improvements. It directly concerns deployed language-model inference efficiency.

records.title: AgentOpt v0.1 Technical Report: Client-Side Optimization for LLM-Based Agent
records.reason: The abstract formulates client-side model selection for LLM agent pipelines under quality, latency, and cost constraints, using search procedures to reduce evaluation overhead. This is directly about efficient execution of LLM-based agents.

records.title: Accumulator-Aware Post-Training Quantization for Large Language Models
records.reason: The primary title and abstract identify accumulator-aware low-precision post-training quantization for LLMs. The method addresses accumulator overflow while retaining model quality at low precision, targeting practical inference datapath efficiency.

records.title: FG²-GDN: Enhancing Long-Context Gated Delta Networks with Doubly Fine-Grained Control
records.reason: The abstract introduces channel-wise delta updates and decoupled key/value scaling for gated delta networks, a linear-attention alternative with linear-time inference. It reports stronger associative recall and long-context understanding at comparable compute.

records.title: Sparsified State-Space Models are Efficient Highway Networks
records.reason: The abstract introduces token pruning in state-space sequence models and reports improved tasks at the same FLOPs, with better information flow over long sequences. This is a specific efficiency method for a sequence-model architecture.

records.title: Beyond Mean Attention: Diversity-Aware, Layer-Wise Scoring for KV Cache Eviction
records.reason: The abstract adds attention dispersion and redundancy to KV-cache eviction scoring without extra forward passes, then evaluates retained quality across LongBench. This directly optimizes LLM inference memory use.

records.title: A Performance Study of LLM Inference on Mooncake-Based Clusters
records.reason: The official ICCE-Asia 2025 program book confirms this exact title and authors, but no primary abstract was retrieved. The official IEEE Xplore document page for DOI 10.1109/ICCE-Asia67487.2025.11263536 returned a JavaScript-disabled / robot-verification page, and the DOI resolver led to that page; the available primary program entry contains metadata only. Keep as borderline pending abstract-level scope evidence.

records.title: Absorber LLM: Harnessing Causal Synchronization for Test-Time Training
records.reason: The abstract describes absorbing historical context into model parameters through causal synchronization for test-time training, with the stated objective of reducing inference memory while retaining long-context capability. This is a concrete memory-efficiency proposal for LLM inference.

records.title: Attention as Conditioning: What Classical Learning Theory Predicts About Linear Transformers
records.reason: The abstract analyzes linear-transformer state updates as associative conditioning and studies their memory and in-context retrieval properties. The work directly concerns the computation and state representation of a linear sequence architecture, a plausible efficiency lineage for inference systems.

records.title: Compressing Pre-trained Models of Code into 3 MB
records.reason: The abstract presents a compact architecture that compresses pretrained code models to 3 MB and reports substantially smaller and faster inference than CodeBERT/GraphCodeBERT baselines. It directly addresses model footprint and inference latency.

records.title: GRAFT: Adaptive DLM-Based Draft Tree Construction with Target-Distilled Edge Scoring
records.reason: The abstract describes adaptive draft-tree construction for diffusion language-model speculative decoding, distilling target-model edge scores to guide expansion and improve serving speed. This directly targets inference latency.

records.title: FastTTS: Accelerating Test-Time Scaling for Edge LLM Reasoning
records.reason: The abstract proposes speculative beam extension, asymmetric memory allocation, and prefix-aware scheduling/KV reuse for edge LLM reasoning; it reports higher goodput and lower latency. These mechanisms directly target edge inference efficiency.
